P_unconditional_StageA.note: 0 observed direct cell interactions in 100k full-beam histories

P_conditional_StageA_analytic.note: E[1-exp(-mu*chord)] over aimed beam footprint; mu from imported XCOM row

P_conditional_OpenMC.stddev_note: OpenMC statepoint std (1.6e-6) is a batch-replicated statistic (10 batches) and is ~3.6x tighter than the idealized Bernoulli std (5.8e-6); rare-event batches are mostly zero, so the batch statistic underestimates. Reported uncertainty here is count-based (Wilson 95% CI) instead.

definitions.P_conditional: P(primary photon interacts in ROI | photon crosses ROI footprint)
definitions.P_unconditional: P(primary photon interacts in ROI | photon launched from full source)

chord_distinction.frozen_baseline_8.6e-5: max (diametral) chord through ROI center: 1-exp(-mu*2R), R=5 um
chord_distinction.mean_chord_beam_6.7e-5: E[1-exp(-mu*chord)] over uniformly sampled impact parameters; mean chord = pi R / 2 = 7.854 um
chord_distinction.note: Both estimate P(interact | photon crosses ROI); the difference is geometric (max vs mean chord), not physical or numerical.
